t: This was the site of the Sackville Gallery, an art gallery at 28 Sackville Street. It ran from 1908 to 1912, and it's best known for hosting the exhibition of Futurist art in 1912. The gallery was run by Max Rothschild and Robert René Meyer-Sée, who is recorded as its founder. René de Marmande, a French journalist and art dealer, is also listed among its owners. Rothschild and Meyer-Sée were both London art dealers. I don't have more detail on what else was shown here, but that Futurist show is why the gallery is remembered.
